target_gates.description: One living operator remains visibly responsible for the event.
The bounded arrival source is complete and spatially anchored.
The arriving entity is separately embodied and not an operator duplicate.
Gesture, gaze, and orientation form a clear operator-to-entity relation.
A companion portrait, empty circle, corpse animation, or generic glow does not substitute.
The practitioner visibly controls a material or apparatus operation.
The retort, crucible, vessel, and transfer path remain mechanically connected.
Input and output materials are simultaneously comparable and visibly different.
A bounded material-change zone and process residue remain legible.
Robes, potion bottles, smoke, or laboratory decor alone do not establish alchemy.
